ābhoga.p: [Ā+bhuja+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) (A) Meditation, Bear in mind (or) Concentration and contemplation. (B) The dhamma which can be concentrated and contemplated, Āvajjanaḥ.(2) Respect (or) Revere (or) Fall in (or) Droop. (3) Completion (or) Perfection (or) Fulfillment. (Ti) (4) One who concentrated and contemplated on. .(Āvajjanaḥ means contemplation (or) apprehension (or) fluency (or) eloquence).
